technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with bullish MACD/PPO crossovers and three white soldiers pattern offset by price below key moving averages (50-day), bearish cloud position, and weak volume support.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 18) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale vs 2 purchases, all small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings binary in 14 days compounds downside risk for IT sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO bullish crossovers and three white soldiers pattern suggest early momentum reversal with price near support (108.735) offering defined risk entry in extreme fear environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all key moving averages (50-SMA, 50-EMA, 200-EMA), Ichimoku bearish cloud, high earnings risk in 14 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and below-average volume undermine momentum signals and create severe macro/event headwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: MACD/PPO crossovers and three white soldiers offer early momentum signal at support level in extreme fear environment. However, macro headwinds, earnings binary in 14 days, and technical weakness below all key moving averages create asymmetric risk unsuitable for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creates binary downside risk that overwhelms technical momentum signals; price below 50-day moving averages suggests trend remains bearish.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show bullish momentum signals, but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents strongly oppose entry due to macro environment, earnings proximity, and lack of smart money support
decision.portfolio_note: Existing IBM position and 21 open IT sector positions create concentration risk; high sector volatility and portfolio drawdown at 0% argue against adding exposure before earnings clarity.
